laws.rule: Table Mountain National Park daily conservation fees, 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027, international visitors: Cape Point R592 adult (12+), R288 child (2 to 11); Boulders R282 and R138; Newlands, Oudekraal, Silvermine and Tokai R230 and R115. (No RBA rate for ZAR; at the South African Reserve Bank rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 11.7177 ZAR: R592 ≈ A$50.52; R288 ≈ A$24.58; R282 ≈ A$24.07; R138 ≈ A$11.78; R230 ≈ A$19.63; R115 ≈ A$9.81)
Cape Point and Boulders gates are cash-free (cards only); one payment per vehicle at Cape Point. The standard (international) rate is applied unless South African ID is shown.
